Name: LOBBY_MENU_PARAM_ST
Description: Destinations of the Roundtable Hold travel menu (Expeditions, Character Selection, Change Garb ...): names, map icons, warp points and the flags that show them or open their menu on arrival.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 6 rows.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: Name of this destination (Menu Text) in the Roundtable select menu.

Fields.Name: Warp Point Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of the point the player is warped to. Also the map pin's position when Map Position Entity ID is 0.

Fields.Name: Menu Auto Open Event Flag
Fields.Description: By its name, the event flag that opens this destination's menu automatically after the warp (read through an accessor whose consumer was not followed). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Appearance Event Flag
Fields.Description: The destination is listed in the select menu and on the map only while this event flag is on. 0: always.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of the destination's pin on the Roundtable map. 0: no pin icon.

Fields.Name: Is Underground Layer
Fields.Description: 1: the pin belongs to the map's lower layer. Retail: 1 only on Crypt, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Flagged Warp Value
Fields.Description: Passed to the warp when this destination is picked, but only while event flag 10000926 is on. What it changes is not established. Retail 1 (Expeditions, Character Selection, Relic Rites) or 2.

Fields.Name: Map Position Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID that places the destination's map pin. 0: use Warp Point Entity ID. Retail: only Expeditions sets it.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail 0 on every row.
